migration.migration_reason: A preserved paid Semantic Compression metric shard with the same scientific experiment identity as the recertified owner was rebound to the current canonical catalog. Explicit legacy fragments, when present, matched exactly; the current metric validator re-checks the result.

evidence.basis: all-fragments (Quidra only; n_L = 38 of 44 probes supported, 6 NONE). Common-basis figure (probes supported by ALL ten languages) cannot be computed by this single-language shard and must be produced by the runner after merging every language's shard, per common_basis_rule.
evidence.capability_coverage_note: Reported only as an audit cross-check; Capability Coverage C itself is a separate requirement (spec 6.1.5) and is not this worker's assigned metric.
evidence.execution_caveat: packet-only mode has no compiler access, so fragments were not literally built/run under the frozen recipe (V1 in pre_measurement_validation). All FULL/PARTIAL/NONE determinations and complexity counts are grounded in explicit citations to the embedded Quidra specification text rather than executed evidence. This is recorded as an evidentiary limitation, not hidden.

frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.context_dependent_rules: Count of rules whose meaning at that site depends on surrounding static context rather than being locally fixed by the token alone (e.g. numeric-family literal materialization from context per docs/spec/numeric-and-bin.md, contextual tensor/array element-type inference).
frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.distinct_syntax_forms: Count of distinct grammar productions/constructs (per docs/spec/grammar.ebnf and docs/spec/language.md) that must be written to express and correctly interpret the probe's measured_fragment in Quidra (e.g. a binding form, a call form, a match construct each count as one form; repeated uses of the identical form within one fragment are not double counted).
frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.documented_semantic_exceptions: Count of documented special-case/exception rules (from docs/spec/*.md) that a reader must know to interpret the fragment correctly beyond the general rule (e.g. 'const is path-local', 'private is class-member-only', 'array indexing uses one integer index only, no array slicing').
frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.implicit_rules: Count of automatic/implicit behaviors invoked by the fragment that are not spelled at the use site (e.g. implicit checked-overflow arithmetic, implicit deterministic resource cleanup at scope/lifetime end, implicit value-copy semantics, monomorphization).
frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.unknown_marker_note: No sub-count in this run was set to 0 for lack of documentation; every FULL/PARTIAL probe's four sub-counts are grounded in a cited passage of the embedded Quidra spec files. No category lacked a written counting rule, so none was withheld from scoring under the 'do not score a complexity vector whose categories are not governed by a written counting rule' clause.
frozen_counting_rule_declared_before_ann.unsupported_probes: NONE-scored probes contribute 0 to both numerator (complexity units) and to this metric's denominator (supported capability points), per interaction_with_quality_metrics.metric_E_denominator; they are excluded from the complexity count entirely rather than being scored 0 complexity, so a missing capability cannot artificially lower the ratio.

normalization_applied.rationale_and_caveat: The methodology fixes 'lower raw is better' for this metric but does not fix a cross-language min-max normalization formula in the embedded documents, and this shard has no visibility into the other nine languages' raw values (each is produced by a disjoint language-sharded worker). A provisional bounded linear inversion is applied here (raw 0 -> 100, raw >=5 -> 0) so a numeric 0-100 value can be reported for this shard as required by the standard result schema. This provisional score is not a substitute for the run-wide normalization the runner must perform once all ten language shards for this metric are merged; the raw ratio (1.8082) is the authoritative figure for that later step.

evidence.raw_capability_efficiency_formula: total_semantic_complexity_units / supported_capability_points = 132 / 73 = 1.8082 units per supported capability point (lower is better, per spec 6.1.4.E)
evidence.scope_note: This work unit is a language-sharded packet-only worker assigned only Quidra (per worker_core.md rule 1 and the assigned_requirements.json manifest). Only the Quidra key is populated; the runner is responsible for merging the disjoint per-language shards and for any cross-language common-basis reconciliation (spec 6.1.7 / interaction_with_quality_metrics.common_basis_rule). No sibling-agent output was read, per isolation rules.
evidence.support_rubric_applied: Identical frozen rubric from capability_universe.json support_rubric, applied only to Quidra, using only the embedded Quidra specification documents (language.md, grammar.ebnf, architecture.md, diagnostics.md, numeric-and-bin.md, llm-guide.md, packages.md, patch-schema.md) as the sole source of documented Quidra behavior. No Quidra toolchain was executed (packet-only mode); support/NONE determinations are made from written specification text per R6/R9 as the best available evidence in this mode, and are flagged accordingly.
